title: Enrollment and Spend-Milestone Bonus Levels of Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
The enrollment bonus and the spend-milestone bonus of Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements are set per tier by four figures: the enrollment-bonus points, the enrollment-bonus spend (the flown spend after approval that releases the enrollment bonus), the spend milestone (the agreement-year spend at which the milestone bonus is earned) and the spend-milestone bonus points.

| Tier | Enrollment-bonus points | Enrollment-bonus spend (USD flown after approval) | Spend milestone (USD per agreement year) | Spend-milestone bonus points |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | 1000 | 2500 | 50000 | 2500 |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | 2500 | 2500 | 100000 | 5000 |
| Crestline Corporate Select | 5000 | 2500 | 250000 | 10000 |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | 0 | 2500 | 1000000 | 25000 |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | 0 | 2500 | 2500000 | 50000 |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | 0 | 2500 | 7500000 | 100000 |

### Notes

- The enrollment-bonus spend is USD 2500 on every tier.
- Crestline Corporate Preferred, Crestline Corporate Premier and Crestline Corporate Strategic carry 0 enrollment-bonus points.
- The spend milestone is measured on the spend of one agreement year; the enrollment-bonus spend is measured on the flown spend since approval.

### Hypothetical tier comparison

For a hypothetical agreement year with USD 120000 of spend, the figure lies above the Crestline Business Connect Plus milestone of 100000 and below the Crestline Corporate Select milestone of 250000. The amounts are illustrative inputs only.
